AxisTick.description: `at` is the fraction across (an X tick) or down from the top (a Y tick).
AxisTick.title: AxisTick

CarryPrompt.description: A missed session's proposed carry; nothing moves until the athlete answers.
CarryPrompt.title: CarryPrompt

ChartAxis.description:
The progress chart's scale (metabolism_screen.chart_axis): the value range and
the labels, five from the top and five dates across.
ChartAxis.title: ChartAxis

CheckInValues.description: Every field of the morning check-in; all are required on a save.
CheckInValues.title: CheckInValues

DataCheckOut.description:
The daily data check (services/data_check.py): the rows of the newest
backup that the store no longer holds. Reads only.
DataCheckOut.title: DataCheckOut

ExerciseMove.description:
Which exercises move together when a machine is busy (WP-27,
services/session_order.move_groups): the phone moves whole groups of the
walked steps. A group runs only after every group in `after`.
ExerciseMove.title: ExerciseMove

FlowStep.description:
One position of the guided flow (guided_flow.walk). `event` leads to
the next entry; "skip" leads to `skip_to`.
FlowStep.title: FlowStep

HealthOut.description: Diagnostics only: no personal reading, ever.
HealthOut.title: HealthOut

Hypnogram.description:
The stage strip and the movement strip on one clock. `note` is what the
source line says: "phantom", "watch" or "plain".
Hypnogram.title: Hypnogram

Notice.description: A sync notice: level "error" or "caption"; the phone holds each code's words.
Notice.title: Notice

OuraStatus.description: The Oura login's state. Never a token.
OuraStatus.title: OuraStatus

PointDetail.description: What one tapped point of a chart says about itself.
PointDetail.title: PointDetail

RawSetIn.description:
One set as the phone saw it (rebuild Phase 6); the engine builds the
record (session_save.records_from_raw).
RawSetIn.title: RawSetIn

ReadinessBand.description:
The words services/dashboard.readiness_meta gives a score. The phone
shows them; it never maps a number to a band itself.
ReadinessBand.title: ReadinessBand

RegionPanel.description:
Where the load landed. state "empty" carries `reason` ("rolling" or
"no_split") and the unmapped names; state "split" carries the rest.
RegionPanel.title: RegionPanel

RetestNotice.description: flexibility.retest_notice: kind warning or info; status tomorrow, ready or blocked.
RetestNotice.title: RetestNotice

ScheduleNote.description: Why a day's session sits where it does; `moved` only when it really moved.
ScheduleNote.title: ScheduleNote

ShiftPrompt.description: Readiness suggests moving today's session; nothing moves until the athlete answers.
ShiftPrompt.title: ShiftPrompt

SideIn.description: One side's numbers in a set: reps and weight, or a timed hold's seconds.
SideIn.title: SideIn

SyncRun.description: The engine's last sync run: each step's (ok, error).
SyncRun.title: SyncRun

TapBand.description:
A tappable band over a chart or strip, with the detail of the reading
(or the run) at its centre.
TapBand.title: TapBand

TrainingDayOut.description:
`route`: rest, past_completed (with `logged`; None when its detail could
not be read), past_missed and future (with `planned` and `swap`), today
(with `overview`), no_phase (with `gap`) or phases_unreadable.
TrainingDayOut.title: TrainingDayOut

VerdictBanner.description: The session's load decision: kind error, warning, info, neutral or "".
VerdictBanner.title: VerdictBanner

VerdictOut.description: Today's training decision, as Home and Training both show it.
VerdictOut.title: VerdictOut

WakeControl.description:
The wake-time correction (Key Rule 4's one manual correction). The −
and + buttons send `decrease_to` and `increase_to`.
WakeControl.title: WakeControl

WarningsOut.description:
Insights › Warnings since 2026-10-21: the days the app told him to
lower the load (services/load_warnings.py).
WarningsOut.title: WarningsOut

WeekBanner.description:
The rollup banner (training_week.banner); `progress` is
metrics_logic.week_progress's kind: no_plan, ultimate, perfect, failing
or normal, with `to_go` sessions to the next line.
WeekBanner.title: WeekBanner

get.description:
The daily data check: the rows of the newest backup the store no longer
holds. Reads only; the Worker's daily trigger and Settings' "Check now"
call it. Ages are in hours, so it needs no caller day.

The days the app told him to lower the load, one month at a time
(services/load_warnings.py; the owner, 2026-10-21).
